title: The First Ally
next_chapter_hook: Just as that spiritual sense quietly retreated, a voice rang in Chen Ji's ear: 'Do you want to survive? Do you want to overturn this dead game? Follow me.'

text.content: That spiritual sense pierced his back like an ice pick, yet Chen Ji's steps did not falter for even a moment. He knew that in this chess game, being noticed was not terrifying—what was terrifying was being noticed by the wrong person. The crowd's noise enveloped him, and the gray robe of the Servant Disciple allowed him to perfectly blend into the background. His heartbeat remained steady, even a faint smile playing at the corners of his lips—the moment one is discovered by a hunter is precisely the turning point he had been waiting for.

dialogue.content: Uninvited yet so composed. Chen Ji, you're more interesting than I imagined.' The voice came from the side, carrying a hint of languor yet concealing an edge beneath. Chen Ji glanced over to see a woman in black robes had somehow appeared beside him, half her face covered by a silver mask, revealing only a pair of deep, dark eyes. In those eyes was something similar to his own—calculation and composure honed through life's most desperate moments.

text.content: Ye Qing. He recognized her almost instantly. The Holy Sect's Saint Maiden of the Demonic Path, someone who should have been an enemy rather than a friend, yet here she was appearing in Tianqing Sect's territory. Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart—why had she come? Was she friend or foe? Or another variable in this chess game? His expression revealed nothing, only giving a slight nod as his voice remained as flat as if discussing today's weather: 'Saint Maiden gracing us with your presence, Chen is remiss in not welcoming you sooner. Though I wonder what draws the Saint Maiden to this bustling market.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing let out a light laugh, tinged with mockery, though it was unclear who she was mocking. 'Something worth coming for personally?' She lowered her voice, leaning closer, 'For instance, a fool daring to attend a banquet alone. For instance, a madman chosen by the Tianji Record yet content to be a废物. For instance—' She paused, a complex light flickering in her eyes, 'Someone with a blood feud against Cang Yutian.'

text.content: Cang Yutian. This name was like a blade precisely stabbing into the most hidden corner of Chen Ji's heart. The supreme ruler of the heavenly realm, the actual controller of all worlds, the true master behind Tianqing Sect—and the original strategist behind that incomplete Tianji Record. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly before returning to normal. He turned aside, back facing the crowd, his voice low enough for only two people to hear: 'Saint Maiden's information is quite well-sourced. I just wonder where this "blood feud" comes from.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's smile faded, her eyes beneath the mask turning dark as an abyss. 'Where does it come from?' Her voice carried suppressed hatred, 'Three hundred years ago, Cang Yutian sought a breakthrough and used my entire Ye family to perform a blood sacrifice for the Demon Heaven Formation. One thousand three hundred and seventy-two lives were merely stepping stones in his eyes. My father's head was hung at the city gate for three days as a warning—all because he was one of the candidates for the Tianji Record.'

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression undisturbed, yet his heart was already turbulent. Tianji Record candidate—another person chosen by that mysterious ancient scroll. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had mentioned about the past, remembering those predictors who had fallen like shooting stars through the long river of history, suddenly feeling that the shackles on this woman before him might be heavier than he had imagined. 'So, what the Saint Maiden wants is revenge?' he asked.

dialogue.content: 'More than just revenge.' Ye Qing's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, 'I want to overturn this chess game. Cang Yutian has been setting pieces for ten thousand years, viewing all under heaven as chess pieces. The Tianji Record is merely a tool in his hands; the predictors of each era are merely sources of nourishment. You think you were chosen as a heaven-sent favored son?' She嗤笑一声, 'No, you are just a pig he raises. When it's fat enough, it's time for slaughter.'

text.content: These words were like a basin of ice water poured down, yet they also quietly touched something within Chen Ji's heart. He knew better than anyone the price of the Tianji Record—every glimpse of the future was eroding his life. Pig—what an accurate metaphor. He thought of those vague prophetic visions, recalling how his Heavenly Fate Value dropped sharply after every 'seeing', suddenly feeling perhaps he had always been watched by some more ancient power.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words were like tearing open a blood-soaked wound, laying bare his long-held speculations. Was he to trust this fellow traveler also crushed by fate, or remain vigilant?

choices.description: Since we are both wanderers adrift in this world, let's be frank with each other and jointly plan strategies against Cang Yutian.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal some secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust and establish a true alliance
choices.risk_hint: The other party may still be hiding something; revealing one's trump cards too early carries risk

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly. That smile held no mockery, no probing—only a serenity after traversing vicissitudes. 'Good.' He said just one word, yet it seemed to exhaust all his strength, 'Since the Saint Maiden has been so candid, if Chen continues to hold back, it would indeed appear petty.'

choices.memory_label: 与夜清建立深度信任，坦诚相告天机录的部分秘密

choices.description: Agree to cooperate, but first exchange intelligence to ensure both parties have sufficient leverage.
choices.visible_reward: Gain cooperation possibility without fully revealing trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May cause the other party's dissatisfaction and miss the best opportunity

dialogue.content: Cooperation?' Chen Ji raised an eyebrow slightly, his tone carrying a playful edge, 'The Saint Maiden speaks beautifully, but Chen is merely a humble servant in Tianqing Sect—how could he stand as an equal with the Demonic Path's Saint Maiden?' He paused, shifting topics, 'However, Chen would like to first hear how the Saint Maiden plans to "overturn the chess game."'

choices.memory_label: 与夜清建立有条件的合作关系，相互试探

choices.description: Decline cooperation politely but express willingness to stay in contact and observe the other party's subsequent moves.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve one's own secrets and avoid being drawn into unknown whirlpools
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might turn and leave, missing an important source of intelligence

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped back, creating distance between them. 'Chen appreciates the Saint Maiden's kindness.' His voice was light, betraying neither joy nor anger, 'Only Chen is of humble origin and dares not befriend the Demonic Path's eminent figures. Besides—' he glanced at the surging crowd around them, 'Here人多眼杂, some words are better left unsaid.'

choices.memory_label: 暂时拒绝夜清的合作提议，保持观望态度

text.content: Ye Qing was not angered by his probing; instead, her admiration deepened. 'Interesting.' she murmured softly, 'Truly someone who can survive under the Tianji Record's curse.' She raised her hand, fingertips condensing a jet-black token like ink, 'This is the '幽冥令' of my Holy Sect. Whoever holds it may enter our Holy Sect's secret passages, bypassing the many eyes Cang Yutian has set in the heavenly realm.'

dialogue.content: She extended the token toward Chen Ji, her voice carrying a rare solemnity: 'I am not begging for your cooperation. I am telling you—in this chess game, you are not fighting alone.' She paused, adding: 'Cang Yutian's power runs far deeper than you imagine. He has operated in the heavenly realm for ten thousand years; on the surface, he dominates the three major sects, but in reality...' Her voice dropped even lower, 'Hidden deeper within the heavenly realm are forces even more ancient than him.'

text.content: Even more ancient forces. These words were like thunder rumbling in Chen Ji's heart, exploding outward. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's words that always stopped short, remembered certain cryptic symbols in the Tianji Record he still could not decipher, suddenly feeling the heavens above seemed far heavier than he had imagined. The moment he accepted the Dark Nether Token, he felt a chill in his palm—the token seemed alive, automatically hiding itself within his body.

choice.prompt: At the moment the Dark Nether Token entered his body, Chen Ji felt a certain sincerity from Ye Qing. This was an important moment of decision—to fully open his heart or maintain an ambivalent distance?

choices.text: Accept the Token and Truly Bond
choices.description: Regard Ye Qing as a true ally and begin sharing some secrets about the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a comrade-in-arms who can guard one's back
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing has ulterior motives, one will be completely exposed

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at the black patterns lingering on his palm, then suddenly laughed. That smile carried both relief and determination. 'Good.' he said softly, 'Since the Saint Maiden is willing to place her bet, Chen will gamble this round with you.' His voice was soft yet each word crystal clear: 'The foresight of the Tianji Record is not without cost. Every time I 'see,' it consumes my Heavenly Fate Value—and once that value is exhausted, it's death.'

choices.memory_label: 向夜清坦白天机录的部分代价，正式建立同盟

choices.text: Accept the Token but Keep Silent
choices.description: Accept this kindness, but regarding the secrets of the Tianji Record, say nothing for now.
choices.visible_cost: May make Ye Qing feel insufficiently sincere
choices.visible_reward: Retain core trump cards, leaving room for the future

dialogue.content: 'Chen is honored to receive this gift from the Saint Maiden.' Chen Ji cupped his hands, his expression showing恰到好处的感激, 'Only Chen feels unworthy and fears disappointing the Saint Maiden.' He paused, shifting topics, 'However, if the Saint Maiden does not嫌弃, Chen is willing to serve as a暗桩 within Tianqing Sect, exchanging information.' Ye Qing looked at him deeply, seemingly sensing something, yet only nodding slightly: 'Very well.'

choices.memory_label: 接受夜清的令牌合作提议，但保留核心秘密

text.content: Ye Qing seemed to sense the turmoil in his heart, yet did not press further. She merely stood quietly by his side, her voice suddenly becoming very soft: 'The first time I saw you was three months ago, on a rainy night.' Her gaze drifted toward the distance, as if piercing through the bustling crowd before her, 'You stood at the Cliff Edge, covered in wounds, clutching a残破的书页 in your hand—at that moment, I saw something identical in your eyes.'

dialogue.content: 'A flame still burning amidst despair.' She turned her head, and beneath the mask, her eyes held a rare warmth, 'So I chose to bet on you.' These words were light, yet they struck Chen Ji's heart heavily. He suddenly recalled that rainy night—the clumsy moment after he first used the Tianji Record to foresee the future, the night he almost died. So at that time, someone had already been watching him in the shadows.

text.content: He suddenly felt his eyes sting with emotion. This feeling was too unfamiliar; it took him several breaths to realize what it was—the emotion of being truly 'seen.' Walking alone under the Tianji Record's curse for so long, he had long grown accustomed to solitude, to viewing everyone as chess pieces on the board, to trusting no one. Yet now, this woman who should have been an enemy had, with a simple sentence, pried open the hardest wall in his heart.

'Saint Maiden...' His voice was hoarse, yet quickly regained its composure, 'Chen feels unworthy.' Ye Qing laughed lightly, that laugh holding no mockery—only an insight into worldly affairs. 'Unworthy?' she countered, 'How many废物 in this world could have been actively chosen by the Tianji Record?' She raised her hand, fingertips lightly touching her heart, 'Someone whose heart can hold the world's chess game yet remains unfrozen—such a person is rarest of all.'

Chen Ji was stunned. He gazed at this woman who had been soaked in hatred for three hundred years, suddenly discovering how similar the flames in her eyes were to his own. Both were people who rose again after being crushed by fate, who never gave up struggling in the darkness, who longed for a true ray of light. At this moment, the wall named 'defense' in his heart quietly developed a crack.

dialogue.content: 'That even more ancient force within the heavenly realm...' Ye Qing suddenly lowered her voice, her expression growing grave, 'I only know one name—'Eye of Heavenly Dao.'' These four words were like a basin of ice water, chilling Chen Ji's just-warmed heart to the bone. Eye of Heavenly Dao? He recalled a certain taboo existence Mo Xiansheng had once mentioned, remembered those dark symbols in the Tianji Record that he instinctively avoided, suddenly feeling an icy chill penetrating to his marrow.

choice.prompt: 'Eye of Heavenly Dao'—this name was like a bolt of lightning splitting Chen Ji's understanding of the heavenly realm. Faced with this truth that could overturn everything, how should he respond?

choices.description: Since we've come this far, we might as well completely unveil this veil and see the true landscape of the heavenly realm.
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon forbidden knowledge that should not be known
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may not know more, or knowing too much might be dangerous

dialogue.content: 'Eye of Heavenly Dao.' Chen Ji rolled this name on his tongue, his voice steady, 'May the Saint Maiden tell me what exactly this is?' Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, seemingly weighing how much to reveal. 'All I know is...' she slowly began, 'It is neither human nor deity. It is some kind of... will. A will surpassing Cang Yutian. Cang Yutian claims kingship in the heavenly realm, yet before it, he is merely another chess piece.'

choices.memory_label: 从夜清处得知「天道之眼」这一终极存在的存在

choices.description: Engrave this information in the deepest part of one's heart and wait to gather more clues before making judgments.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for deeper understanding
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself and not prematurely expose one's knowledge

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not press further. He merely engraved these four characters into the deepest recesses of his heart, then gave a slight nod: 'Many thanks to the Saint Maiden for the reminder.' Ye Qing glanced at him, seemingly sensing something, yet chose not to expose it. 'You are more composed than I imagined.' she said softly, 'This is excellent. In this chess game, the one who lives long is the true winner.'

choices.memory_label: 将「天道之眼」的信息暂时封存，等待更多信息

text.content: The crowd gradually dispersed and the market's bustle began to subside. Ye Qing turned her head toward Tianqing Sect Main Peak, a complex light flickering in her eyes. 'I should go.' she said, 'Coming here today was precisely to meet you. Now that the purpose is achieved.' She took a Jade Slip from her sleeve and extended it toward Chen Ji, 'This contains a trace of my spiritual imprint. If there's urgent matter, crush the Jade Slip and I will know.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji accepted the Jade Slip; the moment his fingertips touched its cool surface, he suddenly spoke: 'Saint Maiden.' Ye Qing paused mid-step, looking back at him. 'That rainy night three months ago...' his voice was soft, 'Thank you.' Ye Qing froze for an instant, then smiled. That smile came through the mask, carrying both释然 and warmth. 'No need to thank.' she said, 'I simply didn't want this world to have yet another lonely spirit.' As her words fell, her figure merged into the crowd like flowing black ink and vanished in an instant.

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone in that spot, the Jade Slip warm in his hand. The setting sun's afterglow fell upon him, stretching his shadow long. He raised his head toward the horizon; Ye Qing's parting words echoed endlessly in his mind—Eye of Heavenly Dao, Cang Yutian, Tianji Record, and those taboo truths hidden within history's depths. All of this was like a giant net, and he stood precisely at its center. 'Eye of Heavenly Dao...' he murmured to himself, his voice dissipating in the evening breeze. In the distance, the first star quietly brightened, as if some silent gaze was penetrating the layers of clouds and mist, falling upon this seemingly废物 youth.
